description: Extend a photo with AI-painted surroundings: to a new shape such as 16:9 (a cover), 9:16 (a phone story) or 1:1, or by a share of its size on the sides you choose. It never crops: the original pixels stay as they were. Can take up to a minute. 5 free runs a day for each image tool, then 25 credits a run, charged only when the result is ready. Give the photo as file_id (the user uploads it through get_upload_link) or image_url. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

aspect_ratio.description: The shape to reach, like 16:9, 9:16, 4:5 or 1:1. Give this, or the sides.

bottom.description: Height to add at the bottom, as a share of the photo's height.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the photo there.

image_url.description: Or a public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo. A result link from another YangOpen image tool works too.

left.description: Width to add on the left, as a share of the photo's width (0.5 adds half).

right.description: Width to add on the right, as a share of the photo's width.

top.description: Height to add at the top, as a share of the photo's height.

name: expand_image
title: Expand a photo past its edges
